bug_semantics: In ReadRequestFromClient (os/io.c), an oversized Big Request is not disconnected; leftover payload is tracked as ConnectionInput.ignoreBytes and skipped instead of parsed. After consuming a request, if gotnow becomes 0 the same ConnectionInput buffer is published on AvailableInput and later recycled to another live client via FreeInputs. The share predicate historically checked only !gotnow, so a client that finished a request with leftover ignoreBytes could donate a buffer whose ignoreBytes was still nonzero. The next client then entered the ignoreBytes path and skipped its real request, hanging that client (DoS). CWE-667 / local authenticated availability. First-party fix: only set AvailableInput when !gotnow && !oci->ignoreBytes.
flaw_origin: Aaron Plattner 2010-08-27 cf88363db0ebb42df7cc286b85d30d7898aea840 ('os: Return BadLength instead of disconnecting BigReq clients (#4565)') first added ConnectionInput.ignoreBytes, the oversized-BigReq ignoreBytes = needed-gotnow assignment, and the ignore-now block that did oci->ignoreBytes -= gotnow; needed = gotnow = 0. Zeroing gotnow forced the pre-existing if (!gotnow) AvailableInput = oc share without requiring ignoreBytes==0, so leftover ignore state could transfer with the recycled buffer. Parent fa22f97af65efc2a147e9be0b7f288848965ff60 has no ignoreBytes field or ignore path (oversized BigReqs YieldControlDeath()/return -1). Later c80c41767e refined ignore consumption, 67c66606 reset ignoreBytes only in FreeOsBuffers on disconnect, and f993091e7d rewrote the share if as a poll(2) refactor; none is first-write of the leftover-ignoreBytes + AvailableInput mechanism.

reasoning: The CVE is a real, still-published DoS: leftover ConnectionInput.ignoreBytes can ride an AvailableInput/FreeInputs recycle onto another client and cause ReadRequestFromClient to skip that client's request. First-party X.Org text, the one-line fix, and the pre-fix function all agree on that mechanism. git log -S ignoreBytes plus parent-tree inspection show the smallest first-write is cf88363db0 (2010-08-27), which added ignoreBytes and forced gotnow=0 on the ignore path without gating AvailableInput on ignoreBytes==0. Parent fa22f97a still disconnects oversized BigReqs and has no ignoreBytes field, so the flawed interaction is absent there. That commit is a normal single-parent change, not a move/refactor/squash; later ignoreBytes and poll refactors are not first-writes. It is in 1.10 RC1/1.10.0 and not in 1.9.5, matching the advisory's introduced-in tag; the cited fix d55c54ce (and 21.1/24.1 cherry-picks) land at the patched 21.1.17 / 24.1.7 boundary.
